text:
jess: Opening warroom handback for Keystone tenant — p95 timeouts + 502s started ~02:15 UTC, customer reported retries/latency. Root cause under investigation. @omar @natalie please join. cs-lead looped.
omar: On it. I'm seeing traces that point at increased ingress queue latency and backend 502 spikes; possible pool exhaustion. Pulling logs now.
natalie: Auth proxy shows a cluster of 504s at the same window. Token refreshes look suspiciously dense. Fetching auth logs.
alex: Metrics: batcher queue depth jumped from ~10 -> ~120 at 02:14, p95 tail latency up to 2.3s. Uploading heatmap to thread. Correlating with ingress spikes.
jess: Customer impact: repeated 5xxs over ~30m; immediate mitigations proposed: 1) enable degraded routing to fallback model variant, 2) temporarily bump ingress concurrency, 3) CS to ask customer to pause traffic/revert deploy. Who takes which?
omar: @alex I can flip degraded routing now. Confirm fallback model supports basic text-gen for Keystone payloads?
alex: Fallback model supports inference-only calls (not function-calling). ~95% of Keystone traffic is plain text-gen — safe to route. I'll coordinate with @omar and watch outputs.
natalie: Auth team: we see a burst of token refreshes tied to Keystone client keys. CS says customer pushed a deploy at ~02:10 without exponential backoff. Requesting they pause traffic.
cs-lead: CS has reached out to Keystone and requested a pause and rollback. Customer acknowledged and started rollback; ETA ~15m.
alex: Flipped degraded routing -> fallback model. Early metrics: 5xx rate down ~60%, p95 decreased ~800ms. Monitoring. :thumbsup:
jess: Action items (owners + ETA):
- omar: autoscaler threshold tweak + ingress concurrency bump (ETA 10m)
- alex: validate fallback correctness + monitor for regressions (ETA 5m)
- natalie: auth rate-limit rule to throttle token refresh (ETA 20m)
- maria: CS comm draft to Keystone with ETA and rollback note (ETA 10m)
We'll record these in the postmortem ticket.
maria: Draft ready, sending to cs-lead for approval. cc @jess
omar: Autoscaler tweak applied; queue depth trending back to normal. Leaving runbook note.
Command used:
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-batcher -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
```
natalie: Auth rule deployed: token refresh spikes now rate-limited to 10/s per client key. Watching auth error rates.
jess: Schedule follow-up postmortem in 48h. Preliminary RCA owners: batcher behavior (alex/omar), auth surge (natalie), customer SDK/backoff guidance (maria/cs-lead). Add anything missing.
sre-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 02:55 UTC; active mitigations in place. Please create postmortem ticket: PM-1751239876.
cs-lead: Customer rollback confirmed; they report visible improvement. Will coordinate long-term SDK/backoff guidance with product.
jess: TL;DR for postmortem: likely root cause = customer deploy causing token-refresh storm which amplified batcher queue and exhausted ingress pools. Mitigations enacted: degraded routing to fallback model, autoscaler bump, auth throttles, customer rollback. Action items captured in PM-1751239876. Thanks all :clap:
